summary: Queries a value associated with a key string formatted by StringFormatWith0x40Size. Failure of formatting returns -1. Otherwise sub_59B760 fills a stack buffer with registry query results; on failure the handle is released via sub_58C331 and -1 is returned, and on success the captured value at TotalBytesAvail[7] is returned after releasing the handle. Called from SceneTrackFileLoader.

operations.description: result = StringFormatWith0x40Size(this, 0) formats the key string; -1 signals failure.
Guard on result != -1; on formatting failure the function returns -1 directly.
sub_59B760(result, TotalBytesAvail) fills the stack buffer; its boolean result decides success.
When sub_59B760 returns non-zero (failure), release the handle with sub_58C331(v2) and return -1.
v3 = TotalBytesAvail[7] captures the registry query result from the stack buffer.
sub_58C331(v2) releases the query handle before returning the captured value.
Return the captured value v3 on success, or -1 on any failure path.

unresolved: Exact roles of sub_59B760 (query execution) and sub_58C331 (handle release) are inferred from control flow only.
Meaning of TotalBytesAvail[7] and the buffer layout are unknown.
What registry key/value pair this queries and how the returned value is consumed by SceneTrackFileLoader are unverified.
